sources.label: Morphe patches for the Avito Morocco app
sources.author: Nizarberyan Avito
patch_list: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store.

Changes the app package name to allow installing the same app multiple times. By default ".morphe" is appended to the package name. Each cloned install must use a unique package name. Cloning does not work with all apps and using this patc…
Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting
Removes the ad network banners from the search results and from the listing pages, and stops the app from requesting ads.
Hides listings posted by shops (boutiques) from the home feed and from search results. Search results show shop listings again when a seller type is selected in the search filters.
Removes the sponsored campaigns Avito serves itself on every screen: the sticky banner, notification ads, swipe-up ads and touching points.
Overrides certificate pinning, allowing to inspect traffic via a proxy.
Spoofs the package signature of the original APK.
